script_text: Stop! Aries, the cosmos has secretly built an invisible wall between your heart and your career today. Transiting Mars, your ruling Fire planet, pushes through your 7th House of Partnerships in a tense square to Saturn in your 10th House of Career, creating friction between love and ambition. If you're taken, keep workplace frustration far from your partner tonight or arguments will spiral; if single, don't force a connection being pressured by outside obligations. Saturn's heavy grip on your 10th House of Career means a long-awaited opportunity feels stalled — resist the urge to push harder, or you'll burn the bridge you're trying to build. One thing you must avoid today is letting old resentment fester in a partnership that's trying to survive this very tension. Follow for tomorrow's Aries daily reading, because Jupiter is about to shift the game completely.
